_comment: Numeric telemetry inputs present in the AMS2/Evo MoTeC channel lists or shared-memory structures. Channel paths are source-specific; factor and offset convert source values to unit.
_comment_pmr: PMR UDP live capture (Phase 3). PMR LIVE rows use packet-path style channel keys that MUST match the raw dictionary built in PmrFeedLap() exactly. Guarded channels (throttle, brake pedal, steer angle, yaw rate, G-forces) arrive pre-computed with full-precision constants from C++, so their factor is 1.0; fuel arrives only when capacity > 0 and remaining is finite.
